question: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) was launched in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)** is one of the public distribution system schemes in India implemented from **2000**.
 
• The main aim of the scheme was to **provide highly subsidized food grains** to the poorest of the poor families in rural and urban areas.
 
• The scheme** primarily targeted households that were living below the poverty line (BPL)** and did not have a regular source of income.
 
• Benefits under AAY scheme:
 
 
• It offers **wheat at Rs. 3 per Kg** and **rice at Rs. 2 per Kg**. 
 
• Eligible **families can get 35 Kg of rice every month. **
 
• They can also purchase** 1 Kg of suga**r from the ration shop **at Rs. 18.50 per Kg**.​
